incident-bot: [ALERT] realtime-api: sustained p99 latency > 700ms (5m). Auto-pulse flagged. paging: oncall
Priya: on it. I’m oncall for this slot. gathering quick context :mag:
Priya: Mateo / Alex — any active deploys or rollout jobs in eu-west-1?
Mateo: Not seeing any explicit deploys. CI shows canary job finished ~10m ago but rollout paused. Checking metrics now.
Alex: grabbing traces. p95 is up ~250ms, p99 peaked 900-1100ms. Looks concentrated on streaming endpoints and long prompts.
Priya: linking dashboards — realtime-slo: https://internal.dash/realtime-slo?range=5m (please paste if you can't open)
Mateo: KV cache hit rate dropped from 94% -> 47% across gpu-pool-7 (eu-west-1). suspect prefix cache eviction / pressure.
Alex: log tail from one victim node: ```[2026-03-17T02:01:12Z] WARN stream: kv-cache-miss id=abc123 latency=312ms fallback=true```
Priya: customer-impact? Julie — product, any customer tickets?
Julie: We have 2 EU customers reporting timeouts on streaming chat (timeout ~30s). no broad error spike yet but UX degradation.
Mateo: quick mitigation: shift 30% traffic off gpu-pool-7 to gpu-pool-3 (eu-central) and enable prefix read-throughs. proposing route shift command: `redwood route shift --from=gpu-pool-7 --to=gpu-pool-3 --percent=30 --reason="kv hit drop"`
ops-bot: Executing dry-run for `redwood route shift` (id=run-998). No changes applied yet.
Alex: also recommend raising small-model fallback for streaming to reduce token latency: update policy `model.fallback.request_threshold=700ms` -> `200ms` for canary window.
Priya: doing the route shift now. running command.
Priya: ops-bot confirms shift started, 30% -> gpu-pool-3. monitoring p99.
Mateo: after 3 minutes, p99 down to ~480ms and kv hit rate recovering to 78% on gpu-pool-7. good sign.
Alex: rolling prefetched KV batch back in for top prefixes: `redis-cli --eval scripts/prefill.lua prefixes.txt` (started).
Julie: reaching out to the two customers with status: short note drafted — will inform when stable.
Priya: oncall handoff note: Mitigation in progress, route shift applied, p99 improved but still > target. continuing monitoring for 30m. paging SRE for deeper kv eviction analysis.
Mateo: next steps: collect perf profiles from affected pods (heap/GC, disk IO), check eviction policy change 2h ago, and correlate canary job artifacts. I'll own the deeper investigation.
Alex: temp mitigation items logged in runbook: https://internal.runbooks/edge-route-fallback. added commands used and rollback steps.
Priya: updating incident title and severity. tagging postmortem when stabilized. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Incident log appended (id=3069909999). If no further paging, closing active page in 45m unless regressions.
